text:
maria: did a perf sweep on llama3-13b with prod-like chat templates. seeing kernel selector flip around seq=256, p95 spike and KV cache miss storms. suspect head_dim/fused-kernel heuristic + rope_theta interplay.
ashok: which kernel is it flipping between? autokernel -> slow generic? can you share traces?
maria: short excerpt: ```
kernel_selector: fused_attention -> generic_cuda
seq_len_threshold: 256
kv_prefetch_evictions: 37/min
cache_hit_rate(prefix_len>180): 22%
```
dennis: looks like chat template prefixes (~200 tokens) cause lots of warm-starts. batcher groups by model only, not prefix shape, so KV caches never warm and prefetch path evicts. grouping by prefix_hash or limiting prefix in batcher should help.
kai: also note head_dim mismatch. model head_dim=128 but fused-kernel heuristics historically optimized for 96/64 vectors on that kernel. selector currently rejects fused for non-matching stride -> falls back. if we allow fused for 128 we might regain perf.
maria: flipped allow-fused-heads=128 on staging. microbench: p50 32ms -> 30ms, p95 220ms -> 194ms, throughput -4%. small win on tail.
perf-bot: Regression alert: build 2026.03.14 increased device alloc churn in fused_attention path. :warning:
ashok: rope_theta defaults? could RoPE scaling be worsening attention compute at mid lengths causing kernel choice variance?
maria: model catalog currently sets rope_theta=10000 for Llama3. in local stress tests switching to 8192 reduced numerical drift for long-context tests and stabilized kernel selection for seq 512.
dennis: short-term mitigation: set batcher.max_prefix_tokens=128 to prevent huge prefix grouping; also add a prefix_len bucketing policy. I'll draft a PR.
maria: next steps: 1) PR to kernel-selector to accept head_dim=128 fused path (performance test + mem-profile), 2) PR to batcher to group by prefix_hash and add prefix_len bucket, 3) metric: kv_cache_hit_rate by prefix_len and kernel_choice to alert on thrash. opening issues/PRs now. :memo:
kai: pinging @ml-infra for rope_theta catalog change and validating model artifacts.
maria: created issue #4827 (kernel selector fused head support) and PR #3891 (batcher prefix grouping). full traces uploaded: https://perf/reports/2240005678. cheers.
